material_findings: The Replay Gap is A- evidence that static suffix replay can score the wrong post-intervention world under the tested live branching setup; it does not identify the best rollback target selector.
AgentRewind gives paired evidence that rewind availability improves recovery from identical failed endpoints, but checkpoint-target selection quality is not isolated by its ablations.
TraceElephant is strong reproducible attribution/testbed substrate, not evidence that a generic rollback-selector interface or selector advantage already exists.
TelemetrySuffBench strongly separates failure detection from origin localization and supports explicit evidence-sufficiency/abstention gates, within a synthetic/canonical benchmark scope.
